home.about: A one-story home built in 1997 on a private, tree-lined lot in Heath's Candlelite Park, with a circular drive and owned solar panels. The island kitchen opens to the living area, and the backyard holds a custom cedar greenhouse and a TuffShed.

neighborhood.community: Candlelite Park sits in Heath on the shore of Lake Ray Hubbard, a quiet pocket of tree-lined lots and wooded views. Terry Park, with a boat ramp and lakeside trails, is under half a mile away, and Towne Center Park adds playgrounds, pickleball courts and an event lawn. Rockwall ISD schools serve the neighborhood.
